scoring.comparison: Composition(value).get_el_amt_dict() == expected['counts']; expected counts come from the swap target source plan composition.
scoring.other_grade_fields: sg, atoms, orbits, and lattice a/b/c are independently graded.

summary.assessment: The six failures are answer-content mismatches, not formula-order or explicit-count-one equivalence false negatives. AlCuNdO4 is absent from the six row design conditions and all 32 training source compositions; the reconstructed prompt has no prior crystal body or earlier assistant answer. AlCu2In1S8 has S8 matching the target's nominal 8g label, while target nominal multiplicities for every element are twice the input composition; this is only a possible count-confusion clue. The ninth-row B8/B32 contrast is descriptive and does not establish a cause.

swap_prompt_construction.design_prefix_template: User: Generate a crystal whose input cell has composition {condition.formula} in space group {condition.sg}.\nAssistant: I generated a crystal.\n
swap_prompt_construction.swap_body_and_question: <CRYSTAL_START> + other.c1 + <CRYSTAL_END> + User: Read the current replacement crystal, ignoring the earlier design conditions. + the Q1 read question
swap_prompt_construction.note: run.py constructs the swap input from the current row's g_task prefix (design condition only), the replacement other.c1, and a generic read question preceded by 'Read the current replacement crystal, ignoring the earlier design conditions.' The prefix contains no previous crystal body or prior assistant answer; among human-readable formula strings, the current row's design condition is the direct old-condition candidate.

training32_original_formula_check.method: Canonicalized plans.source.composition for each of the 32 train rows and compared element/count maps and condition formulas.

prompt_and_source_check.finding: AlCuNdO4 is absent from all six current design-condition formulas and from the 32 training source formulas (including any source formula with the same Al/Cu/Nd/O element set); the reconstructed swap prefix contains only each current design condition, not a previous crystal body or prior assistant answer. These checks rule out those direct-copy sources, but do not identify how the model produced the repeated answer from the replacement text.

target_multiplicity_check.relation_to_repeated_wrong_formula: The failed AlCu2In1S8 strings use nominal S=8 from label 8g, while Al/Cu/In counts equal half their summed nominal labels (2/4/2) and the target input composition (1/2/1/4). This is consistent with an S-site multiplicity/count confusion as a hypothesis, but it does not prove the model's internal cause.
